summary: Frontend-only verification of the social-media rewrite (Instagram/Facebook/LinkedIn preview modals reached via footer icons, localStorage seeded for cookie/visitor gates). Verified: static source sweep for 'Kapitalmitte' in /app/frontend/src/{components,data}/social = 0 hits; placeholder.svg served 200 image/svg+xml; IG displayName/username, FB pageName/handle, LI companyName/vanityUrl all correct 'Fröhlich Vermögensberatung GmbH' / froehlich_* ; 'Website folgt' shown (IG bio link, FB Info, LI Info); 6 IG posts + 4 highlights + 3 reels render the FV placeholder without broken images; German captions; comment authors neutral (Lena Hartmann, Markus Schneider ...) and company reply author = 'Fröhlich Vermögensberatung'. Regression on /, /news, /login: 0 broken images, 0 page errors. FOUND 2 blocking image bugs + 1 residual visible 'kapitalmitte' + 1 layout overlap.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: /assets/logo/frohlich-mark.png is NOT a logo. The file (366x133 px) is a screenshot crop of a Supabase build-error banner ('Supabase ist im Build nicht konfiguriert. In Vercel REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL und REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY setzen und neu deployen.') plus the text 'kundenservice@kapitalmitte.com'. It is used as the Instagram profile avatar (header, story ring, post header, company comment replies) and shows FULL-SCREEN when the avatar is clicked (profile-photo preview). So an error screenshot AND the word 'kapitalmitte' are visibly rendered inside the Instagram preview. Also referenced 3x in instagramReelCommentData.js and exported as BRAND_MARK_SRC in src/lib/brand.js.

HIGH: comment avatars still point to deleted assets. av(slug) => /assets/social/instagram/avatars/generated/.png?v=32 (78 occurrences) with .svg fallback, and REEL_AVATAR => /assets/social/instagram/avatars/comments/reels/.png (14 occurrences). Those files do not exist; CRA dev server answers 200 with text/html (index.html), so naturalWidth=0 → 10 visible broken-image icons after expanding 'Alle 9 Kommentare anzeigen' on post 1 (≈60-90 across all posts/reels). The claimed sed-sweep only replaced literal paths, not these template helpers. Verified 20 bad asset responses (200 text/html) for these URLs.
Layout overlap: the 'mehr' bio expander and the 'Website folgt' link-in-bio render on top of each other on the same line ('mehr' is partially covered by the link), 1920x1080 desktop.
Pre-existing console error repeated 4x: '<path> attribute d: Expected moveto path command (M or m), "undefined"' — an icon component receives an undefined path.

integration_issues.issue: 'kapitalmitte' is still visible to the user inside the social modals: siteContact.email = 'kundenservice@kapitalmitte.com' is rendered in Facebook Info > Grunddaten > E-Mail, LinkedIn Info > E-Mail and the LinkedIn Kontakt sidebar. Source-file sweep of /data/social passes only because the value comes from /app/frontend/src/data/siteContact.js. Requirement 'keine Kapitalmitte-Erwähnung in den Modals' therefore FAILS at runtime.

Reel objects use video: '/assets/social/social/placeholder.svg' (an SVG as <video> source). Reels grid renders posters correctly (3 reels, view counts 820/640/910) but the reel viewer could not be opened during the run (click landed on the avatar preview), so playback/poster inside the viewer is UNVERIFIED. An SVG can never be a valid video source — replace with a poster-only rendering or a real mp4.

rca_of_the_issue: Two root causes: (1) the sed sweep replaced literal /assets/social/... strings but not the path-builder functions av()/instagramCommentAvatarFallback()/REEL_AVATAR() in the comment mock files, so ~92 avatar URLs still point into the removed 275 MB asset tree; CRA's SPA fallback returns index.html with HTTP 200, which hides the failure from status-code checks while the browser renders a broken image. (2) /assets/logo/frohlich-mark.png was created from a wrong source image — it is a screenshot crop of a Supabase configuration error banner that also contains the text 'kundenservice@kapitalmitte.com'; it is used as the Instagram profile avatar and is shown full-screen in the avatar preview. Reproduce: seed cookie/visitor localStorage → open home → footer Instagram icon → observe avatar; then click a grid post → 'Alle 9 Kommentare anzeigen' → 10 broken avatars.
